chiroso.title: What is Chiroso
chiroso.name: What is Chiroso coffee?
chiroso.description: Chiroso is a variety grown around Urrao, Antioquia, known for a delicate, floral cup. Learn where it comes from, how it tastes and how to buy it.

buying.name: How to buy green coffee from Colombia
buying.description: A step-by-step guide to buying green coffee from Colombia: define your needs, check the producer, taste a sample, understand FOB pricing and plan the shipment.
